title: New MarketConfigurationData causes existing orders to fail
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description  There are three new storage variables (`depthFactor`, `maxExposureFactor`, `maxPSlippage`) in `MarketConfigurationData` that are used to perform slippage and exposure checks in `Market.getPSlippage()`.  The issue that that these new storage variables will be initialized to zero for the existing `Market` as they were previously un-used before this upgrade.
